title: carya texana f. glabra
intro: Carya texana f. glabra, commonly known as the smooth Texas pecan, is a tree species belonging to the Juglandaceae family. The smooth Texas pecan is valued for its rich nutritional profile and medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive compounds present in the smooth Texas pecan, such as ellagic acid and gallic acid, contribute to its overall health benefits and therapeutic potential.
